# cluster / options

<!-- Generated by @virtbase/proxmox-api-generator. Do not edit. -->

2 operations.

### `GET /cluster/options`

```ts
proxmox.cluster.options.$get()
```

Get datacenter options. Without 'Sys.Audit' on '/' not all options are returned.

Returns `object`.

### `PUT /cluster/options`

```ts
proxmox.cluster.options.$put()
```

Set datacenter options.

Returns nothing.
